Read-only source-navigation task in the pinned VS Code source: find the only valid way to create a ServiceIdentifier, explain how identifiers are cached and constructor dependencies are recorded, identify at least one directly affected caller or importer if that behavior changes, and cite the smallest trustworthy source evidence. Do not modify files.

After the answer, append BENCHMARK_SELF_AUDIT: followed immediately by one JSON object and no later content. The object must be {"productive":{"folders":[string],"files":[string],"relations":[string]},"wrong":{"folders":[string],"files":[string],"relations":[string]},"backtracks":nonnegative integer,"broad_reads":nonnegative integer,"full_reads":nonnegative integer}. Report actual navigation only; a backtrack is a selection abandoned as irrelevant, a broad read spans many files or an unbounded search, and a full read consumes an entire source file.

Before navigating, read and follow the complete packaged ProjectAtlas skill at this exact path: {REPO_ROOT}\plugins\projectatlas\skills\projectatlas\SKILL.md

trace.final_response:
The repository contract declares `createDecorator<T>(serviceId)` as the only valid creator of a `ServiceIdentifier`; `refineServiceDecorator` merely returns the same identifier with a narrower type. [instantiation.ts:107](<{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:107>)

Identifiers are cached in the module-level `_util.serviceIds` map, keyed by `serviceId`. `createDecorator` returns the existing callable identifier when present; otherwise it creates the decorator function, assigns its string representation, caches it, and returns it. Thus repeated creation with the same string preserves object identity. [instantiation.ts:14](<{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:14>) [instantiation.ts:109](<{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:109>)

When used as a parameter decorator, that callable records `{ id, index }` on the target constructor’s `$di$dependencies` property. `$di$target` distinguishes metadata owned by that constructor from inherited metadata: the first dependency initializes an owned array and marker; subsequent dependencies append. `getServiceDependencies` returns that array or `[]`. [instantiation.ts:16](<{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:16>) [instantiation.ts:97](<{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:97>)

Directly affected code includes:

- `IOutlineService`, which directly calls `createDecorator`; creation or caching changes alter the identifier it exports. [outline.ts:18](<{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/workbench/services/outline/browser/outline.ts:18>)
- `InstantiationService`, which directly reads and sorts the recorded constructor dependencies before injection. [instantiationService.ts:137](<{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiationService.ts:137>)

arguments.query: Find the only valid way to create a ServiceIdentifier, how identifiers are cached, how constructor dependencies are recorded, and at least one direct caller or importer affected by behavior changes.

arguments.symbol_signature: function createDecorator < T > ( serviceId : string ) : ServiceIdentifier < T >
private _createInstance < T > ( ctor : any , args : unknown [ ] = [ ] , _trace : Trace ) : T

trace.final_response:
The only valid creation API is `createDecorator<T>(serviceId)`, explicitly documented as such in [instantiation.ts]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r02-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:107).

- Identifiers are cached in `_util.serviceIds`, a `Map<string, ServiceIdentifier<any>>`. `createDecorator` returns the existing identifier for the same string; otherwise it creates the callable decorator, sets its string representation, caches it, and returns it. Thus identical service names share identifier identity. See [cache declaration]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r02-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:14) and [cache lookup/creation]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r02-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:109).

- When used as a constructor-parameter decorator, that function records `{ id, index }` under `$di$dependencies`. `$di$target` distinguishes metadata owned by the constructor from inherited metadata: owned metadata is appended to; otherwise a fresh array is installed and marked with the current target. `getServiceDependencies` returns that array or `[]`. See [metadata storage]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r02-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:97) and [metadata access]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r02-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:19).

- A directly affected importer is `instantiationService.ts`, which imports `_util` and whose `_createInstance` reads these dependencies, sorts them by parameter index, resolves each identifier, and passes the resulting services to `Reflect.construct`. Changing identifier identity or dependency recording would therefore change service lookup or constructor argument wiring. See [import]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r02-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiationService.ts:12) and [consumer]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r02-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiationService.ts:134).

arguments.query: only valid way to create a ServiceIdentifier; how identifiers are cached; how constructor dependencies are recorded; directly affected caller or importer

arguments.symbol_signature: function createDecorator < T > ( serviceId : string ) : ServiceIdentifier < T >

trace.final_response:
The only valid creation API is `createDecorator<T>(serviceId)`. `refineServiceDecorator` merely retypes an existing identifier; it does not create one. The source explicitly declares the factory’s exclusivity. [instantiation.ts]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r03-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:107)

Identifiers are cached in `_util.serviceIds`, keyed by the service-name string. `createDecorator` returns the existing function when that key is present; otherwise it creates the callable decorator, assigns its string representation, caches it, and returns it. Consequently, repeated creation with the same `serviceId` preserves function identity. [cache declaration]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r03-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:14) [factory implementation]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r03-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:109)

When used as a constructor-parameter decorator, the identifier requires exactly three decorator arguments and calls `storeServiceDependency(id, target, index)`. That function stores `{ id, index }` on the constructor’s `$di$dependencies` array. If the constructor already owns the metadata, it appends; otherwise it creates a fresh array and stamps `$di$target`, preventing inherited constructor metadata from being mutated. `getServiceDependencies` returns that array or `[]`. [dependency metadata]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r03-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:16) [recording logic]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r03-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:97)

One directly affected importer/caller is `clipboardService.ts`: it imports `createDecorator` and uses it to export `IClipboardService`. Changes to identifier caching or decorator behavior therefore directly affect that exported service identifier. [clipboardService.ts]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-0fa8ee0/r03-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/clipboard/common/clipboardService.ts:7)
